name: venom
description: Multiplayer AI for your team: agents share projects, tasks, decisions and skills through Venom MCP.

interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to Venom, where your team’s agents share projects, tasks, decisions and skills. Hooks ask the Venom server for guidance at key moments, so work stays logged where teammates can pick it up.
defaultPrompt: Find or create the Venom task for this work and keep it updated.
